messages:
Maya (Support): Escalating StationCo trial — embed ingest hitting 429s and occasional generation timeouts during their tutorial flow. Demo tomorrow; theyre hesitating on PO. Need CS to own outreach + enablement.
Jonah (CSM): Got it. Paste the error and org id?
Maya (Support): Org stationco-trial-7. Error: {"error":"quota_exceeded","limit":"ingest_documents_per_minute","usage":95} — reproducible with 500-doc batches.
Eve (CS Ops): I can lift the trial ingest quota by +3x for 36h. Want me to do it now and note timeline?
Jonah (CSM): Yes please lift now. Draft comm: apology + temp lift to keep demo green + invite to a 30m enablement session to run deterministic tests and share remediation plan.
Maya (Support): Also saw generation timeout: {"error":"inference_timeout","latency_ms":15000} when context size > 8k tokens.
Ravi (Eng Runtime): I'll join enablement and run a quick perf profile. Likely fixes: advise chunking attachments and lower concurrency, or route to higher-capacity pool temporarily. ETA 3hrs for initial notes.
Jonah (CSM): Noted. Nina, flag renewal as at-risk until demo completes. I'll send the comms once Maya posts the draft.
notify-bot: Incident INC-2026-5102 created: stationco trial quota uplift (assigned: eng-runtime).
Eve (CS Ops): Quota increased for 36h at 2026-05-02T18:04Z. Logged in account notes.
Maya (Support): Sent draft comm to the customer; they accepted a 30m enablement slot at 09:00 PT tomorrow.
Jonah (CSM): Thanks all. After the call I'll update the account playbook and send a one-paragraph summary to Renewals. Please DM any logs or test outputs. :thumbsup:
__notes: Synthetic Slack thread for support->CS escalation about trial onboarding: quota lift, enablement call, renewal risk. All fields are strings or list of strings per agents.md.
